propositions: Compacted authorship-ledger entries retain pre-rewrite commit SHAs that become invalid after history rewrite, causing the verifier to misclassify authentic events as key-not-valid-at-era.

The verifier must resolve ledger positions against the current tickets history and prefer the resolved commit SHA over the stored pre-rewrite SHA, retaining the recorded SHA only as a fail-closed fallback when position resolution fails.

A real-Git regression must demonstrate that signed events in a compacted ledger preserve their verdicts after commit history rewrite, with all commit SHAs changed but event positions remaining resolvable.
The authorship-ledger schema, event wire format, and live-event behavior must remain unchanged after the fix.
